chart-shell-view.description: Card wrapper with hero KPI, view switcher, period filter, states, and legend composing every chart type.

examples.note: Switch views, change the period, toggle legend series, and open the actions menu. Every interaction lands in the log below.
examples.title: Weekly agent activity

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone chart shell component.

props.note: The shell owns view and period models and emits toggles, actions, and retry. It never fetches and never mutates the series array.

states.note: Loading shows skeletons, errors show a retry action, and empty data shows guidance text.

chart-shell-view.title: Chart Shell
